indents.rationale: Architecture statements are flat; parent relationships do not introduce an author-indented block.

injections.rationale: Architecture labels expose prose, not a separately owned embedded language payload.
Block labels are Mermaid-owned text leaves rather than embedded-language payloads.
C4 arguments are model values, not embedded source languages.
Class members and notes are Mermaid-owned text, not embedded-language payloads.

indents.rationale: Cynefin domain grouping has no explicit begin/end indentation boundary in the CST.

injections.rationale: Cynefin labels are prose and do not declare an embedded language.

locals.rationale: Cynefin domain names are fixed keywords, not user-defined local symbols.

brackets.rationale: Cynefin syntax exposes no paired delimiter children.

injections.rationale: ER attribute comments and aliases are prose, not embedded source.

indents.rationale: Gantt sections are flat statements and do not delimit an indented body.

injections.rationale: Gantt task text and callbacks do not expose embedded-language payload nodes.

indents.rationale: GitGraph is a flat command stream without indentation blocks.

injections.rationale: Commit messages and tags are data strings, not embedded source.

brackets.rationale: GitGraph quoted values are atomic tokens with no paired delimiter children.

indents.rationale: Info contains flat metadata statements only.

injections.rationale: Info metadata does not own an embedded language.

locals.rationale: Info declares no user-defined symbols or references.

brackets.rationale: Info exposes no structural delimiter pairs.

injections.rationale: Cause and effect labels are prose without an embedded-language marker.

locals.rationale: Ishikawa labels form a hierarchy but not a definition/reference namespace.

brackets.rationale: Ishikawa syntax has no paired delimiter children.

indents.rationale: Journey sections do not introduce an author-indented block.

injections.rationale: Journey task text is prose rather than embedded source.

locals.rationale: Journey actors and tasks have no definition/reference ownership relation.

brackets.rationale: Journey syntax exposes no paired delimiter children.

indents.rationale: Kanban layout is scanner-owned, but the admitted named CST does not expose indentation transition nodes for Neovim.

locals.rationale: Kanban item IDs are not referenced by other admitted Kanban statements.

indents.rationale: Mindmap layout is scanner-owned, but the admitted named CST does not expose indentation transition nodes for Neovim.

locals.rationale: Mindmap node IDs do not participate in a definition/reference namespace.

indents.rationale: Packet fields are flat records with no indentation block.

injections.rationale: Packet labels are data strings, not embedded source.

locals.rationale: Packet ranges and labels have no definition/reference relation.

brackets.rationale: Packet quoted labels are atomic tokens without delimiter children.

indents.rationale: Pie sections are flat records with no indentation block.

injections.rationale: Pie labels are data strings, not embedded source.

locals.rationale: Pie labels do not define or reference symbols.

brackets.rationale: Pie quoted labels are atomic tokens without delimiter children.

indents.rationale: Quadrant Chart statements are flat and do not delimit an indented body.

injections.rationale: The admitted CST currently resolves markdown-looking labels as quoted text, so there is no stable markdown payload node to inject.

locals.rationale: Points and classes do not form a coherent diagram-local reference namespace.

indents.rationale: Radar axes, curves, and options are flat statements; braces delimit values, not line indentation.

injections.rationale: Radar labels and values do not declare an embedded language.

brackets.rationale: Radar labels are atomic and curve braces are not exposed as paired delimiter children.

indents.rationale: Railroad expressions may span delimiters but do not define indentation blocks.

injections.rationale: Railroad strings and special expressions are grammar data, not embedded source.

indents.rationale: ABNF grouping and continuation do not define Neovim indentation blocks.

injections.rationale: ABNF terminals are grammar data, not embedded source.

indents.rationale: EBNF grouping and continuation do not define Neovim indentation blocks.

injections.rationale: EBNF terminals and special sequences are grammar data, not embedded source.

indents.rationale: PEG grouping and continuation do not define Neovim indentation blocks.

injections.rationale: PEG literals are grammar data, not embedded source.

indents.rationale: Sankey is a CSV-like record stream without indentation blocks.

injections.rationale: Sankey fields are data values, not embedded source.

locals.rationale: Sankey source and target labels are data, not declarations and references.

injections.rationale: Sequence messages and notes are Mermaid-owned prose without an embedded-language marker.
State descriptions and notes are prose, not embedded source.

indents.rationale: Timeline continuation lines do not define an explicit begin/end indentation block.

injections.rationale: Timeline link-like text is an opaque prose leaf in the admitted CST.

locals.rationale: Timeline periods and sections are narrative, not declarations and references.

brackets.rationale: Timeline inline links are opaque text and expose no paired delimiter children.

injections.rationale: Tree View names and descriptions are prose, not embedded source.

locals.rationale: Tree View nodes form a hierarchy but have no definition/reference relation.

injections.rationale: Treemap names and styles do not declare an embedded language.

locals.rationale: Treemap nodes form a hierarchy but do not reference declared symbols.

brackets.rationale: Treemap quoted names are atomic tokens without paired delimiter children.

indents.rationale: Venn statements are flat; indentation on text is content rather than a block boundary.

injections.rationale: Venn labels, text, and styles are Mermaid-owned values.

indents.rationale: Wardley coordinates and statements are flat; pipeline nesting is not present in the representative source.

injections.rationale: Wardley labels and notes are prose, not embedded source.

indents.rationale: XY Chart statements and arrays are flat and do not introduce indentation blocks.

locals.rationale: Axes and series do not participate in a declaration/reference namespace.
